name: Tokscale auto-publish
description: Publishes your daily token and cost totals per model to the Tokscale leaderboard. Prompts, code, thread titles, project names and file paths are never sent.
longDescription: Publishes your daily token and cost totals per model to the Tokscale leaderboard (tokscale.ai) on a schedule. It sends only the numbers p0code already shows on its Usage page; prompts, code, thread titles, project names and file paths are never sent. Off by default: sign in with a device code or a Tokscale API token. Unofficial: not made or endorsed by Tokscale.
